situation (example wording): "Highlight major crime trends in the city of Philadelphia since 2022", "give me major violent crime in Houston in 2024"
what the app does today: The words "highlight" and "major" were read as part of the question, so it could not tell what was asked.
proposed behavior: "Highlight" opening a question, and "major" before a crime word, are filler ("show me" and "give me" already were): dropped, and the rest is read as usual (the first example answers Philadelphia's crime by year, 2022 through 2025). "Major cities" is not affected: it keeps its own rule (a population of 250,000 or more).
exact default or choices offered: The answer to the question without the filler.
